newsitem.title: LITHUANIA: Lithuania central bank revokes Ekspres license.
newsitem.headline: Lithuania central bank revokes Ekspres license.

text.p: Lithuania's central bank said on Friday it had revoked the license of the tiny Ekspres bank.
The bank, one of the smallest in the Baltic state, is the seventh small bank to lose its licence this year.
The Vilnius district court filed bankruptcy proceedings against the bank on August 16, one month after the central bank suspended most of its activities.

The central bank has tightened its capital and liquidity requirements in a bid to avoid a repeat of the banking crisis which hit the Baltic state late last year with the suprise closure of two of its top banks.
Central bank chief Reinoldijus Sarkinas said on Thursday that the number of banks would be reduced by mergers and market forces.
